help.title: Help
help.intro: A quick reminder of what each module does. A question that isn't answered here? Leave it in Feedback.

accueil.title: Dashboard
accueil.text: The home page sums up your farm at a glance: revenue and expenses for the month, profit, number of sales, plots to water, egg stock, pending deliveries. The “Important alerts” section lists what needs your attention right now.

calendrier.title: Calendar
calendrier.text: Note the important dates for your farm (sowing, treatments, appointments...). Events are shared between all employees of your business, not just saved on your phone.

recoltes.title: Harvests
recoltes.text: Record each harvest: plot, crop, quantity, quality, destination. Choosing the right plot lets you later link a sale to the harvest it came from (visible in a quote's details).

cultures.title: Crops & irrigation
points: Plots: soil moisture and temperature (simulated sensors), watering threshold, automatic mode or manual valve.

Stock: seeds, fertilizers, crop-protection products — quantities, alert thresholds, customizable categories, and a default price per item. That price is suggested automatically as soon as you type the item name in a purchase or a quote.

Batches & log: track each batch with its expiry date. For a crop-protection product, fill in active substance, registration number, buffer zone and pre-harvest interval (PHI) — the treatment log then automatically works out, for every application, the date from which harvesting is allowed again.

Sales / Purchases: go through quotes (Sales module) and the multi-line purchase form (Purchases module — with a real Draft → Ordered → Received cycle, stock and finances only moving on receipt). Every received purchase or signed sale automatically updates your Finances and your stock.
Accounting: total sales and purchases for the module, and the change history.

poulailler.title: Poultry
poulailler.text: Same logic as Crops, applied to livestock: poultry-house temperature/humidity, stock (feed, eggs, birds) with a price catalog, sales/purchases/deliveries, and automatic accounting.

pisciculture.title: Fish farming
pisciculture.text: Same logic as Poultry, applied to fish farming: pond water quality (pH, dissolved oxygen, temperature), stock (feed, fry, fish) with a price catalog, sales/purchases/deliveries, and automatic accounting.

clientsFournisseurs.title: Customers & Suppliers
clientsFournisseurs.text: A single contact record can be a customer, a supplier, or both at once — tick the matching box on the record. Contact details, purchase history for a customer, order history for a supplier. Click a record in the left list to see its details on the right, with the price list possibly assigned to it.

finances.title: Finances & Banks
finances.text: All your transactions: Cash, bank accounts, expenses, net profit. Sales and purchases recorded in Crops, Poultry or via a quote appear here automatically — you can also add a manual operation (salary, fuel, maintenance...). Set a main bank account so sales/purchases are credited there by default.

devis.title: Quotes & Invoices
devis.text: Create a quote by adding product lines (percentage discount possible) or section lines to structure the document, then send it to the customer (by email with an online signing link, or validate it manually if the agreement was given by phone). A product's price is prefilled automatically based on the price list assigned to the customer (managed from Customers), otherwise its default price. Once signed, turn it into an invoice with full payment or instalments — each payment is reflected in Finances. In a quote's details you can also record the quantities actually delivered/invoiced line by line.

salaries.title: Employees
salaries.text: Records for your employees: position, salary, personal contact details. Open an employee's “HR record” for detailed tracking: day-by-day attendance, leave requests (to approve/reject), and salary advances. An employee can have a separate login account (with their own role) — that is different from their personal email. Once signed in with that account, the employee finds their own tracking (leave, advances, attendance, estimated payslip) under “My HR space”.

factures.title: Invoicing & accounting
factures.text: Once a quote is invoiced, the invoice shows up under Invoices with its payment status (unpaid, partially paid, paid) and, past its due date, an “overdue” badge — you can then “Mark as reminded”. To correct an already-posted invoice without deleting it, create a credit note from its detail view. An accounting journal can be secured (🔒 icon) to make its entries immutable once posted; “Verify integrity” recomputes the chain to confirm nothing was altered afterward.

equipements.title: Equipment
equipements.text: Inventory of your equipment: name, category, condition, acquisition date, value. Each piece of equipment keeps a history of maintenance interventions (date, description, cost). Visible to everyone, but only admin/director/manager can add or edit.

observations.title: Observations
observations.text: Free-form field notes, with date and location — handy for recording what you notice in the moment (the state of a crop, a sick animal, an incident...) without going through a specific module.

assistant.title: AI Assistant
assistant.text: Ask a question in plain language about your farm (profit for the month, feed stock, plot to water, best customer, upcoming expenses): the answer is computed from your data, not from an external AI. Exception: until a sensor is connected, plots to water rely on simulated values.

previsionsRapports.title: Forecasts & Reports
previsionsRapports.text: Forecasts estimates your sales, expenses, harvests and profit for next month from your recent trends. Reports gives you the same kind of figures for a past period (day, week, month, year), with export to PDF or CSV.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: List of active alerts: low stock, high temperature, dry soil, scheduled delivery, unpaid invoice.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.text: A suggestion, a frustration, a bug you hit? Say so here — that's what lets us improve the app as we go, with feedback from real users.

profil.title: My Preferences & security
profil.text: Your account information, and enabling two-factor authentication (MFA) to secure your sign-in with a code on top of your password.

faq.intro: Answers to the questions that come up most. Details on each module are further down.

questions: I just signed up and everything says "To activate". Why?

The Crops, Poultry and Fish farming modules are paid and start disabled. Click a dimmed tile on the home screen: it activates and takes you there in one go. Cross-cutting features — contacts, quotes, invoices, stock, HR — open as soon as one of those three is active.
What happens when the 45-day trial ends?

The app becomes read-only for 30 days: you can still view all your data but no longer create or edit. After that, access is suspended until the subscription is activated. Either way, nothing is deleted.
I did not receive the sign-up confirmation code.
You can request a new one from the confirmation screen. If you log in again without confirming, the app takes you back to that screen automatically.
How do I change the currency or the language?
Currency and date format are set in My preferences, for the whole company. The interface language is per user and is chosen in the same place.
I created a quote but my stock did not change. Is that normal?

Yes. Stock is reserved when the quote is SIGNED, not when it is created: an unsigned quote commits no goods. After signing, the quantity becomes "reserved" — still physically yours, but no longer available to sell.
My invoice has a number starting with DEV-. Why?
That is the originating quote number, shown as "Quote reference". The invoice number itself starts with FAC and appears at the top of the document. Two documents, two numbers.
What is the "By stage" view?
The same content as the list, shown in columns by progress: Draft, Sent, Signed, Invoiced. You can drag a quote between columns when the transition is allowed.
Can I edit a quote that is already signed?
You can adjust line quantities, which updates the reserved stock. For a deeper change, set the quote back to draft: the stock reservation is then released.
My customer has no email address.
Email sending is unavailable, but the WhatsApp button still works as long as the contact has a phone number in international format.
The WhatsApp button opens a share sheet instead of sending. Is that a bug?
No. WhatsApp accepts no attachment through a plain link: to actually send the PDF, the app uses your phone's share sheet. You tap WhatsApp, then pick the recipient.
On my computer it opens WhatsApp with a message but no PDF.
File sharing does not exist in most desktop browsers. The app falls back to a message containing a link to the document, which your customer opens to view and download it.
Why do I have to pick the contact myself?
The phone share sheet attaches the file but cannot target a number; a direct link targets the number but carries no file. Neither mechanism does both — we chose the attachment.
I recorded a purchase but nothing entered stock.

A purchase order follows two independent tracks: its commercial state (Draft, Sent, Ordered) and its receipt state. Stock enters — and the expense is recorded — only when you mark the order as received.
What does "Partial receipt" do?

It flags that goods arrive in several deliveries. Note that the app does not record how much was already received, line by line. A partial order is therefore excluded from forecasted stock, and their count is shown separately.
Can I undo a receipt?
Yes, and both the stock and the financial entry are reversed. Conversely, an order whose goods have arrived cannot be cancelled commercially until the receipt is undone.
My item shows a quantity but "Stock by location" does not list it.
An item created with an opening quantity has no location breakdown yet. Run an inventory count on it: the counted quantity is then recorded against the location, even if it is unchanged.
What is the difference between an inventory adjustment and scrap?

Scrap removes goods you lost, broke or threw away: they go to "Losses". An adjustment corrects a counting difference with no identified cause: it goes to "Inventory adjustments". Keeping them apart is what lets you know what you actually discarded.
Can I undo scrap or a count?
Neither. A wrong count is corrected by a new count. This is deliberate: a stock record you can undo proves nothing.
What is a second internal location for?
To tell where goods physically are — a silo, a room, a shed. A transfer moves them without changing the total you hold. The location marked "default" receives purchases and is the basis for counts.
What does "forecasted stock" mean?
What you will hold once pending orders arrive: available plus incoming. Partially received orders are excluded, since what remains to be delivered is not recorded.
Why is a quantity "reserved"?
It is promised by a signed quote but not yet delivered. It is still on your premises — which is why it counts towards theoretical stock during a count — but no longer available for another sale.
How do I correct an invoice that is already posted?
You do not edit a posted invoice: you issue a credit note. Two methods — "refund" creates a draft you adjust, "cancel" settles the original invoice immediately.
What are the general ledger and the trial balance?

The trial balance gives, per account, the opening, the movements of the period and the closing balance; the ledger lists the entries line by line. Only posted documents appear — a draft is not an accounting entry.
My balance sheet shows no equity.

The default chart of accounts has none, and the app posts no closing entry. The balance sheet therefore computes two lines on the liabilities side — current year earnings and retained earnings — which keep assets equal to liabilities.
Deductible VAT looks too low.
It only counts vendor bills entered in Finance → Invoices. Purchases from the Purchases module create no accounting entry, so they are not included. A banner says so on the report.
What does "securing" a journal do?
Posted documents become tamper-proof: hash-chained, impossible to delete or set back to draft. It is irreversible — enable it only if your regulations require it.
Where do plot humidity and temperature come from?
They are simulated values, not real sensors: the app is not connected to any field hardware. They illustrate monitoring, they are not a basis for irrigation decisions.
Is the weather shown that of my plot?
It comes from a real weather service. By default it is the farm location; if you set coordinates on a plot, its own location takes precedence.
What is the "intervention plan"?
A schedule of agronomic milestones computed for the plot's crop from its sowing date. Milestones are saved as activities; regenerating adds new ones without removing the old.
What does "pre-harvest interval" mean in the register?
The date before which the treated plot must not be harvested, computed at entry from the product's interval. A banner flags affected plots, and a filter helps find them.
What is the difference between an employee and a user?
An employee is a personnel record. You can additionally create a login for them: they then receive credentials and access the app according to their role.
Can an employee approve their own leave?
No. They file the request from My HR space; only an administrator or a director approves it, and that approval is what reduces the balance.
What happens if I delete an employee who has a login?
Their access is deactivated at the same time and the action is recorded in the audit log.
The assistant does not answer my questions about the software.
That is expected: it answers about your data — profit, stock, plots to water, best customer, upcoming expenses. For how the app works, this page is the place.
What happens if I lose connectivity?

Changes made offline are queued and replayed when the network returns. Some operations are deliberately excluded — inventory counts, scrap, WhatsApp sharing — because replaying them later against stock that has moved would do more harm than the failure.
How do I enable two-factor authentication?
In My preferences, Security section. Two methods: an authenticator app, or a code emailed at each login.
My question is not here.
Leave it in Feedback. Recurring questions will be added to this page.

comptaEtats.bilanAide: A balance sheet is read at a date, not over a period: only the end date matters. Current year earnings and retained earnings are computed — the app posts no closing entry.
comptaEtats.resultatAide: Income and expenses for the period. Unlike balance sheet accounts, these reset to zero each financial year.
comptaEtats.tvaAide: VAT collected on customer invoices, deductible on vendor bills.
comptaEtats.tvaLimite: Note: purchases entered in the Purchases module create no accounting entry. Only vendor bills created here count towards deductible VAT.
comptaEtats.videResultat: No income or expense in this period.
comptaEtats.videBilan: No balance sheet account with a balance at this date.
comptaEtats.videTva: No tax applied in this period.

simulation.capteurs: Simulated values: no sensor is connected. Do not base any decision on them.
simulation.capteursIrrigation: Simulated values: no sensor is connected, and automatic mode opens the valve based on these values. Do not use them to decide when to irrigate.
simulation.historiqueVannes: No real valve is controlled: these openings and closings come from the simulation (automatic mode) or from the buttons on this page.
